_about: Fun facts, tips and jokes about something or someone: "fun fact about axolotls", "tell me a joke about Katter", "make fun of Katter". Read by the Discord bot (personality.topic_request) and the mod (MerlLines.topicRequest), on normalized text (lower case, no punctuation or apostrophes). A pattern must match the whole text; the subject is in the group named subject.
fact: (.* )?(fun |cool |random |interesting |weird |crazy |surprising |little |good |nice |new )*(facts?|funfacts?|trivia|something (interesting|fun|cool|new|weird)|interesting things?|cool things?|fun things?)( you know)? (about|on|regarding|of|with|for) (?<subject>.+?)( please| pls| plz| merl)?
joke: (.* )?(funny |silly |good |bad |dad |cheesy |little |nice |new )*(jokes?|puns?)( you know)? (about|on|with|for|of) (?<subject>.+?)( please| pls| plz| merl)?
(.* )?(make fun of|roast|tease|poke fun at|joke about|laugh at) (?<subject>.+?)( a (bit|little))?( please| pls| plz| merl)?
(.* )?(say|tell me|tell us) something funny about (?<subject>.+?)( please| pls| plz| merl)?
tip: (.* )?(good |pro |useful |helpful |quick |little |nice |another )*(tips?|tops?|advice|hints?|protips?)( you know)? (about|on|for|regarding|with) (?<subject>.+?)( please| pls| plz| merl)?

player._about: Player lookups on the message as written (any case): explicit ones always look the name up, loose ones only when it's a player Merl knows ("who is Nox" → MrNox), so "who is Arachne" still gets the wiki.
explicit: (?i)\s*(merl,? )?(show me |what does |whats |what's )?(the )?(minecraft )?(skin|profile|player info|player card) (of|for) @?(?<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,16})( look like)?\s*[?!.]*\s*
loose: (?i)\s*(merl,? )?(who is|who's|whos|who was|do you know who) @?(?<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,16})( is)?\s*[?!.]*\s*
